text:
maria: Heads up - noticed invoice-preview shows lower token totals for some tenants after we enabled slabbed route attribution yesterday. Affected tenants all use route_hints. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: saw the spike in support tickets, yes. quick check: are totals lower in preview but correct in final invoices?
aj: looks like preview is undercounting where route attribution falls into 'slab bins' and then gets coalesced. final invoice (post-aggregate) matches ledger. suspect the preview-side sampler/rollup is dropping slab_id dimension.
maria: that matches what I saw - preview for tenant X was ~30% lower for last 24h, final invoice matched expected.
kevin: can you dump a sample event that got coalesced? also which preview pipeline component is doing the aggregation?
maria: here's a sample from debug logs (redacted):
```
{ event_id: "evt_9a3f", tenant: "tenant-x", tokens: 420, route_hint: "embed-heavy", slab_id: "s_3" }
```
kevin: cool. on preview path we do a fold by (tenant, model, route) but slab_id is only forwarded as an optional tag. if slab_id is missing consumer-side we apply default bucket which collapses different slabs.
aj: quick SQL to find how many events lost slab_id on preview: 
```
SELECT count(*) AS missing_slab
FROM preview_events
WHERE event_time > now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND tenant = 'tenant-x'
  AND slab_id IS NULL;
```
kevin: run that on canary preview dataset and compare to final-ingest where slab_id is present. my hunch: router serialization prunes low-cardinality fields when payload > 1.5kb.
danielle: console UX question - should preview UI surface a per-route "slabbed attribution" toggle? product asks for simple yes/no. If we add it, will it fail open (show best-effort) or block preview?
aj: show best-effort with a tooltip: "Slabbed attribution is experimental; preview may omit slab breakdown for high-cardinality workloads." We can also add a small warning banner when sample rate > 0.5 or missing slab tag rate > 10%.
maria: ops note: customers saw billing surprises; we should prioritize making preview conservative (i.e., favor showing a higher estimate) or at least annotate uncertainty.
kevin: agreed. immediate fixes: 1) patch router proto so slab_id is always forwarded (low-risk), 2) update preview aggregator to preserve slab_id dimension when present, 3) add console flag and uncertainty banner.
aj: I can PR the preview-agg change. patch plan: preserve slab dimension in aggregation keys, but cap number of slabs we keep per-tenant to avoid explosion. evict with LRU on >100 slab keys.
kevin: that cap makes sense. make sure to emit telemetry metrics: preview.slab_evictions and preview.slab_missing_rate. wire to existing dashboard card.
danielle: for rollout UX - plan A: deploy router proto change to dedicated canary (5% traffic) + preview agg patch in canary; monitor preview.slab_missing_rate and invoice delta for canary tenants for 48h. If good, roll to 100%. Also schedule product comms about "preview accuracy" while we roll.
maria: tagging @billing-team FYI - we might need to re-run invoice previews for last 48h for any impacted tenants if we flip to conservative estimates.
kevin: ingest-bot posted: "ingest-bot: preview_events_processor applied slab retention cap=100 to canary cluster at 2026-03-22T14:12:03Z" - confirm logs.
aj: I'm splitting into two PRs: (A) router proto forward slab_id (B) preview agg preserve slab keys + eviction. will also add the two telemetry metrics.
danielle: UI work: I'll wire the banner and toggle to the preview page. text copy: "Preview may omit slab attribution for high-cardinality routes; enable 'show slab breakdown' to see best-effort breakdown (may be incomplete)."
maria: action items: - kevin: coordinate router proto deploy to canary (owner) - aj: PR preview agg + metrics (owner) - danielle: add banner/toggle copy + flag in console (owner) - maria: run one-off query to identify tenants with >10% preview vs invoice delta and raise support tickets if needed
kevin: timeline? aim for canary this week, roll to 100% early next week if stable.
aj: will have PR by EOD, include unit test for evict logic.
kevin: thanks. small follow-up: please add a console metric card that shows preview_vs_final_delta percent for top 10 tenants so product can monitor.
danielle: noted. I'll prototype the card.
maria: thanks team. if anyone finds a tenant with >30% mismatch, ping me directly. :exclamation:
